Before changing this repository, read and follow CLAUDE.md at the repository root. It is the single
source of truth for publishing pages (front matter: title, date, topic, type, summary), the site's
house style (one or two `<mark>` highlights per piece, red margin notes written as a blockquote
followed by `{: .note}`, no inline styles or colours), chart rules (Plotly HTML in
dataanalysis/assets, embedded with an iframe; lead PNG via tools/chart_image.py), and the build check.
